implemented: the production taskbar exposes an owned Task View control and a platform-key plus Tab keyboard route
Task View probes IVirtualDesktopManager capability at invocation time
eligible live top-level windows are revalidated and queried for owned virtual-desktop GUID values
observed window membership is grouped deterministically by desktop ID without retaining HWND or COM pointers in UI state
the GPUI Task View renders a full-work-area dialog with accessible tablist/tab semantics, focus styling, Left/Right navigation, Enter, pointer, and Escape routes
a second Task View invocation toggles the existing surface closed
Task View exposes selectable window rows and capability-gated Move selected here controls for every observed destination desktop
Up and Down select a window, Left and Right select a destination, and M emits the same typed move effect as the pointer control
the production move callback re-resolves the WindowId, revalidates the live HWND, calls documented MoveWindowToDesktop, and re-queries the desktop GUID before reconciling membership
when the documented Windows API cannot enumerate or switch desktops, the surface truthfully keeps switching disabled and exposes the unavailable reason
no undocumented create, remove, rename, enumerate, or switch COM interfaces are invoked

capability_boundary.move_window: runtime probed and available through the documented adapter
capability_boundary.enumerate: unavailable without a separately admitted adapter
capability_boundary.switch: unavailable without a separately admitted adapter
capability_boundary.create: unavailable without a separately admitted adapter
capability_boundary.remove: unavailable without a separately admitted adapter
capability_boundary.rename: unavailable without a separately admitted adapter

remaining_external_api: add a separately versioned and admitted adapter only if Microsoft publishes stable enumeration and switch contracts for the supported Windows target
